# Internal Control and Regulatory Compliance Review

This document details critical actions required for maintaining robust risk and compliance posture:

*   Optimize internal controls quarterly.
*   Urgently review internal controls.
*   Urgently optimize for regulatory changes.
*   Monitor and update regulatory changes standards.
*   Update AML detection systems for the 2026 strategy.
